title: Braun UNKNOWN User and Privileged Control-Plane Audit

findings: Manual Override for Pods disabled; remote access allowed to S. Braun with privileges.
Neural inputs updated to override memory access for individual users.
User UNKNOWN Altered by S. Braun.

MQ04Script.finding: Quest script exposes PlayerInChair, PlayerInTL, DadInfo, DadDogInfo, BraunInfo, SafetyLock, NPCReset and invasion/reset state, but contains no direct memory-carrier COPY/WRITE/EXPORT operation.
MQ04Script.important_boundary: The ordinary quest controller is not itself the demonstrated per-user memory administration implementation.

BettyScript.finding: Braun/Betty can operationally reset simulation residents, including resurrection, relocation and AI-package reevaluation, demonstrating privileged state mutation outside the player-facing Version Control menu.

MQ04PlayerPodScript.finding: The player's lounger has a dedicated activation/transition script, supporting a separation between physical pod control and simulated-world state handling.

support: James is a late entrant to Vault 112.
Braun performs an explicit James-specific alteration: James is represented as Doc.
Version Control independently records an UNKNOWN user altered by Braun.
counterevidence: The Lone Wanderer is also a late entrant and can satisfy an UNKNOWN-user interpretation.
No reviewed primary INFO/result-script or quest-stage binding identifies the Version Control UNKNOWN entry as James.

privilege_model.public_surface: Failsafe/Version Control terminal exposes informational and failsafe functions.
privilege_model.quest_surface: MQ04Script coordinates transitions, tasks and failsafe state.
privilege_model.braun_surface: Documented remote pod privilege, per-user memory override and demonstrated resident/James state alteration.
privilege_model.conclusion: Absence of a player-visible memory write command is not evidence that Braun lacks an internal privileged memory operation.

new_localization_of_missing_edge.known_left: James-specific pod/session + Doc representation + Braun privileged per-user memory authority
new_localization_of_missing_edge.known_right: Braun-held populated mem chip -> Pinkerton -> A3-21 memory integration
new_localization_of_missing_edge.missing: Internal Braun-side selector/serializer binding a chosen resident memory state to the removable carrier
new_localization_of_missing_edge.search_implication: Prioritize dialogue INFO result scripts, hidden/cut quest result fragments, Braun authentication/control records and carrier-side references rather than the public terminal menu.
